primary_skill.instructions: Which skill family is the primary fit for `request`?

criteria.clinical_audit: SOP, kit-insert, or clinical lab audit
criteria.audio: Voice or audio generation and transcription

needs_multi_skill.instructions: Will this task likely need more than one skill combined?

true.what: The request spans two or more of the listed families
examples: Extract a PDF then build slides from it

false.what: A single family covers the whole request
false.not_for: A task that merely touches several files of one kind

is_urgent.instructions: Does `request` convey time-sensitivity or a blocking failure?
